note: Classes below were checked against the official ISLRTC chart 'English Alphabets in Indian Sign Language'. The chart was read by an AI assistant, not by a qualified ISL signer or interpreter. Each class has signer_confirmed set to false until a Deaf ISL signer or qualified ISL interpreter confirms the handshape. Do not use these classes for an evaluation claim until that confirmation is recorded. Only classes with verified true can be recorded by collect_static.py.

class_schema.label: The letter used as the class name
class_schema.hands: 1 or 2, matching the handshape on the reference chart
class_schema.meaning: What the sign means in the reference
class_schema.reference: Source id from sources plus the page or cell used
class_schema.verified: true only after a check against the reference
class_schema.signer_confirmed: true only after a Deaf ISL signer or qualified ISL interpreter confirms the handshape
